about_the_game:
100 Greece Cats - Artbook DLC includes a collection of high-resolution artworks featured in the main game.

Once purchased and activated, you'll find a folder in the game's installation directory containing all included images in their original quality. These are the same visuals used throughout the game—perfect for fans who want to take a closer look at the game's art style or use the images as wallpapers or print it.

This DLC does not include new gameplay content or features. It is intended purely as a visual bonus for those who enjoyed the game's artwork.
